interpretation: CoreCLR comparisons use default checker concurrency, 60 warmups and 30 measured fresh-program requests for each of ten workloads, with Go included. Every request checks its source graph and diagnostic count. All raw results and budget outcomes are retained. NativeAOT uses six fresh process pairs and is recorded separately in method-splitting-replications.json. Phase medians need not sum to total medians.

disposition.reason: Binder/checker extraction increased their total code, did not demonstrate a consistent whole-program benefit, and was associated with slower text controls. The final printer/library-only source is validated and measured separately.

rejectedPatch.appliesTo: Retained printer/library source; applying this patch restores the four-target experimental source.
